def get_ludic(n):
    """Return a list of all ludic numbers less than or equal to n."""
    if n < 1:
        return []

    # Standard ludic sieve (OEIS A003309): start with 1, 2, ..., n.
    # 1 is ludic and is never used as a removal step. The first step is 2,
    # which removes every 2nd element counting from 1, so 2 itself survives
    # only because it is the step value and positions are counted over the
    # list with 1 fixed at the front.
    nums = list(range(1, n + 1))
    i = 1  # index of the next sieve step; nums[0] == 1 is skipped

    while i < len(nums):
        step = nums[i]
        if step > len(nums):
            break
        # Keep 1 (position 1) and otherwise drop every step-th element.
        # Counting starts after the leading 1, so positions are (pos - 1).
        nums = [x for pos, x in enumerate(nums, start=1)
                if pos == 1 or (pos - 1) % step != 0]
        i += 1

    return nums
